messages:
michael: Quick sync — I'm updating the model catalog entry for zephyr-mini-v2. Need limits, a short migration note from the old alias, and an SDK v3 snippet showing the new variant/fallback param.

sara: Are we formally deprecating the old 'zephyr-mini' alias or just soft-deprecating it?

michael: Soft-deprecate: keep a compat note mapping old alias -> zephyr-mini-v2 but advise new calls use the v2 name.

linh: Drafted an SDK snippet for the docs. Putting it here to iterate:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
response = client.responses.create(
    model="zephyr-mini-v2",
    input="Summarize the following: ...",
    max_output_tokens=512,
    params={"variant": "int8-fp16-fallback"}  # prefer int8, fallback to fp16
)
print(response.output_text)
```

oliver: Small runtime note: the param key is fine, but call pattern should show handling for streaming vs non-streaming. Suggest adding a short example for streaming clients too.

linh: updated streaming example quick patch:
```python
with client.responses.stream(model="zephyr-mini-v2", input="Generate TL;DR...", params={"variant":"int8-fp16-fallback"}) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.delta, end="")
```

sara: Also add explicit sequence-window limit. For v2 the context window is 4096 tokens (include that in the limits table). Also add a note that embeddings are not supported on this variant.

michael: Good call. Add a compatibility matrix row linking older quant profiles (zephyr-mini-int8) -> variant name (int8-fp16-fallback) and a short bench link for throughput numbers.

linh: Bench link (internal): https://internal.redwood.ai/bench/zephyr-mini-v2 — provides 95th p90 latency and throughput at different batch sizes. I'll add a short summary sentence in the card linking to that.

docs-bot: PR opened by @linh: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4822 — contains patch: limits table, compat row, and both snippets. CI started. :eyes:

michael: assigning review to @sara for wording and @oliver for runtime compatibility / streaming example sanity check.

sara: I'll review and push copy edits today. I'll soften the 'deprecation' language and add one-sentence upgrade guidance (search-and-replace alias in infra configs).

oliver: runtime looks fine but flagging Dedicated behavior: in Dedicated clusters variant selection can be locked by admin profiles. Add a short note under "Deployment/Compatibility" about reserved capacity enforcing variant selection and how to request fallback in that environment.

sara: ack — I will add that paragraph and run link checker.

michael: thanks — after @sara approves I'll merge once CI passes. small follow-ups: add a unit test snippet for examples/ that runs the non-streaming snippet (fast smoke test).

linh: adding a one-liner pytest in examples/ to validate import and basic call (mocked). Will push to PR.

michael: perfect. thanks all :tada:
